💾 Task 3: Understand how <span id="assignment.2.8"/> replicates your data
========================================================



  


Let's look at *how* the storage backend stays healthy. Every disk <span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> hands to a VM or a pod is a **<span id="assignment.2.8"/> volume**, and every <span id="assignment.2.8"/> volume is created from a <span id="assignment.21.1"/>: a policy that decides, among other things, how many copies of your data exist at any given time.
